Observations.Name: Null-user authorization without a verified key suppresses the native service
Denial happens before a request scope is created
Null-user result is the reported generic not-found exception
Authorization adapter returned a non-null info object with null User
Empty token with null User is still rejected
Unknown token with null User is still rejected
Account token resolving to null User is not treated as a server key
Verified active server key reaches the native service
Server-key scope is re-verifiable by its token
Server-key result remains authorized while the key is active
Revoked server key fails the result/writer recheck
No source record rejects even an empty denial set
Recorded empty source accepts an empty denial set
New unexcluded denial rejects that same source

Limit: Production component check with adapters and an empty library; no native HTTP, real API-key store, personal inventory, Linux runtime or latency measurement. Not a product acceptance result.
